sections.title: Scope
sections.text: These terms establish the general conditions for using the public OGC APIs provided by the Directorate-General for Territory (DGT).
requirements: API use must comply with applicable legislation.
API use must comply with the applicable data licence conditions.
API use must comply with the technical conditions defined in this documentation.
